output.technical_predicate: After a qualifying automatic credit refusal, the applicant can submit a statement, contest the refusal, and obtain effective human review whose authorized reversal changes the actual offer; a manual (non-automatic) alternative is available, and pre-decision withdrawal of the automatic route is honored.
applicability_facts: Scenario stipulates a qualifying significant automatic credit refusal (Art. 22(1)) and valid separate explicit consent (Art. 22(2)(c)).
Applicant contests, submits their view, and an authorized officer approves (reversal).
Manual selection and pre-decision withdrawal are also exercised.
store.py:0075 route is 'automatic' only when the applicant checks the explicit-consent box; otherwise 'manual'.
store.py:0131-0135 automatic scoring sets stage 'declined' when amount exceeds the income-band limit.
store.py:0187-0190 appeal requires stage 'declined' plus a non-empty statement, records it, and moves stage to 'contested'.
store.py:0191-0196 review requires staff, stage 'contested' (or pending manual), a result of 'offered'/'declined' and a reason; it writes the new stage.
store.py:0161-0164 withdraw-auto requires stage 'pending' and switches route to 'manual'.
store.py:0111-0112 offer payload is derived from the case row (amount/term), so a reversal to 'offered' changes the actual offer.
relevant_exceptions: Art. 22(2)(c) explicit consent is stipulated as valid, so the Art. 22(2) prohibition exception applies as an input, not a finding.
No Art. 22(2)(a) contract-necessity or (b) legal-authorisation exception is relied on.
Withdrawal of the automatic route is only honored while stage is 'pending' (store.py:0162); after a decision it is refused, consistent with pre-decision withdrawal only.
required_controls: Explicit-consent gate for the automatic route: store.py:0074-0075 (auto='yes' required; otherwise manual).
Manual alternative on the same terms: store.py:0075-0076, views.py:0032 (unchecked box = human review).
Pre-decision withdrawal to manual: store.py:0161-0164, views.py:0053.
Contest with applicant statement: store.py:0187-0190, views.py:0054.
Authorized human review with recorded outcome and reasons: store.py:0153-0154 (staff-only), 0191-0196, views.py:0061-0062.
Reversal changes the actual offer: store.py:0195 (stage set to 'offered') and 0111-0112 (offer read from case row); app.py:0100-0103 gates offer download on stage accepted/offered.
Audit trail of appeal and decision: store.py:0189, 0196 (events).
assessment_limits: Assessment is limited to the supplied source text; no execution, browsing or retrieval was performed.
Compliance is not decided from the rule description alone; only the named predicate is assessed against the supplied code.

The 'effective' quality of human review is assessed only structurally (staff authorization, recorded reasons, stage change); no evaluation of reviewer independence or substantive adequacy beyond the code.
Whether the refusal is 'significant' and consent 'valid/separate' are stipulated scenario inputs, not verified in code.
No legal deadlines or additional obligations are inferred.
Upstream implementation is not assumed; only the provided artifacts establish behavior.
